_doc: The default GNN of each task, used when a script does not name one
(load_model(task); gnn_models in grand/analysis/example/config.py). A script can name
another: "name/version", "name" (its latest version) or a directory.
a relative path is relative to this file. device: cpu, cuda or auto.
Another settings file can be chosen with $GRAND_GNN_SETTINGS.
